editorial:
Imagine waking up and realizing your neighbor is completely losing his mind. You get pulled into a dark, tense world where a man is obsessed with a creepy, pale blue eye that looks like a vulture's. He spends his nights sneaking around, trying to prove he is sane while planning something terrible. The vibe is very heavy and moody, making you feel like something bad is about to happen at any second. It is a small story with just a few characters, but that just makes the tension feel way more real and scary as you watch the main guy spiral.

The acting is great because you really feel the panic building up. The best part is how the sound design plays tricks on you, making you wonder if you are hearing things too. It moves quickly, though some slow parts might feel a bit long if you want non-stop action. If you enjoy psychological creeps, you should definitely check this out. You can rent it on Apple TV for a quick movie night, or if you want the best picture, try streaming it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video to see all the dark details.
endingExplained: At the end, the man thinks he got away with the crime after hiding the body under the floor. When the police arrive, he acts cool until he starts hearing a loud thumping sound. He thinks it is the dead man's heart beating louder and louder. He eventually snaps and screams his confession to the police, ripping up the floorboards to show the body because the noise in his head became too much to handle.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves short horror stories and creepy characters.
